sources.name: CMS Doctors and Clinicians National Downloadable File (dataset mj5m-pzi6)
sources.note: Medicare Care Compare clinician-location records; filtered to 6 NE states.

sources.name: Medicaid Provider Enrollment Segments (CMS/T-MSIS via HHS Open Data)

method: Filtered both national files to CT/ME/MA/NH/RI/VT. Deduplicated clinicians to unique Type 1 NPIs. Joined the latest Medicaid enrollment segment (by segment end date, then start date) per NPI within each state and classified status.

status_definitions.Active: Latest segment shows active Medicaid/CHIP enrollment
status_definitions.Active - Do Not Pay: Enrolled but flagged do-not-pay in source system
status_definitions.Terminated/Denied/Suspended: Latest segment shows enrollment ended or barred
status_definitions.No Medicaid record in extract: In Medicare file but no NE Medicaid segment 2018-2024

limitations: Medicaid data ends Dec 2024 (2024 preliminary). Status does not confirm current 2026 participation, specific plan/network acceptance, languages, accessibility, or new-patient status. Confirm directly with provider or health plan.
